title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance — combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.

title: Tech manager infosec seguranca da informacao
description:
Tech manager infosec seguranca da informacao

Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Gestão de Equipes de InfoSec: Liderar, motivar e desenvolver o time de segurança, garantindo excelência técnica e evolução de carreira;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Conformidade: Mapear riscos, acompanhar auditorias e manter os controles de segurança atualizados, mitigando vulnerabilidades em sistemas, processos e fornecedores;
  • Estratégia de Segurança: Definir e implementar a visão de InfoSec, alinhando práticas de segurança da informação aos objetivos de negócio e compliance (ISO 27001 e LGPD);
  • Resiliência Operacional: Estabelecer planos de resposta a incidentes, post mortems de falhas e priorização de soluções de longo prazo;
  • Arquitetura Segura: Apoiar times de engenharia e produto na definição de soluções resilientes e seguras, garantindo boas práticas em identidade, criptografia, monitoramento e resposta a incidentes;
  • Governança e Políticas: Estruturar e revisar normas, políticas e procedimentos de InfoSec, assegurando sua aplicação em toda a companhia;
  • Integração com o Negócio: Atuar junto a stakeholders internos e externos (clientes, parceiros e auditores) para demonstrar a maturidade do programa de segurança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência como Tech Manager, Security Lead ou correlata em empresas de tecnologia SaaS;
  • Conhecimento em ISO 27001, LGPD, gestão de riscos, auditorias e SoA;
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes técnicas, incluindo contratação, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e desligamentos;
  • Proficiência técnica em arquitetura de segurança de sistemas web e cloud (identidade, IAM, criptografia, monitoramento, incident response);
  • Experiência em traduzir requisitos regulatórios e de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Familiaridade com gestão de fornecedores de segurança e acompanhamento de contratos/SLAs.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Certificações de mercado: CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 LA/LI;
  • Experiência prática com DevSecOps e integração de segurança em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Atuação prévia em empresas SaaS da área fiscal/financeira;
  • Experiência em FinOps aplicado à segurança, com otimização de custos de ferramentas e licenças;

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 adiantados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This role reports to the Director of IT. You will be customer-facing and the first line of support, owning the support experience for employees via tools like Slack and Jira.   • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear writing for tickets, emails and Slack.

Nice to Haves:

  • Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line tooling; Jamf and Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment, values-driven, empathetic, and collaborative.

Benefits

  • Competitive PTO and a meaningful career with purpose.
  • Inclusive, diverse and equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests available during recruitment.

Equal Opportunity

Help us change lives

At Exact Sciences, we’re helping change how the world prevents, detects and guides treatment for cancer. Join our team to find a purpose-driven career, an inclusive culture, and robust benefits to support your life while you’re working to help others.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and oversee the operational aspects of a study including planning, start-up, enrollment and close out activities ensuring that deliverables are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with department procedures, applicable regulations and quality standards.
  • Prepare, review and implement study related plans and documents including project timelines, study protocols, informed consent forms (ICFs), recruitment plans, monitoring plans, study budgets, site contracts & budgets, vendor management plans and other essential clinical study documents.
  • Develop plans for systems and materials required to support the efficient execution of clinical studies and is responsible for effective management during the conduct of the study.
  • Develop, implement and maintain tools to manage, monitor and report on study health & operations, project timelines, and study finances to department management and other stakeholders.
  • Participate in study database development by reviewing and contributing to case report form (CRF) design, CRF completion guideline development, edit check & manual data review requirements, and participation in user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Oversee sample management activities including planning, sample handling, kit supply management, sample shipping, processing, and resulting.
  • Develop site recruitment plans and is responsible for the identification, selection, start-up and performance monitoring of clinical research sites.
  • Develop study budgets and is responsible for accurately forecasting and managing study expenses. Oversee site contracting and study budget management including facilitation of site contract and budget negotiations, invoice review and approval, accrual management and maintenance of budget tracking tools.
  • Oversee study and site management activities such as, training, data entry & query resolution, TMF maintenance, and ensure compliance with study plans such as the study protocol, monitoring plans, and recruitment plans.
  • Conduct monitoring activities as needed.
  • Ensure the smooth and efficient closure of studies through development of plans for completion of data verification & review, planning & facilitation of database lock activities, determination of site & IRB/EC readiness for closure, statistical analysis and clinical study report development.
  • Participate in the identification, qualification, selection and management of vendors providing support to clinical studies.
  • Provide oversight and support for assigned clinical operations study team members. Leads cross-functional team meetings, ensuring study goals and priorities are clear. Professionally interacts with investigators and site staff, vendors, key opinion leaders and consultants.
  • Ability to identify, mitigate and manage study risks. Responsible for maintaining ongoing study audit readiness and participates in internal or regulatory authority audits.
  • Provide guidance and support to less experienced team members. Fosters a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment, promoting continuous learning within the team.
  • Ability to provide oversight to multiple studies.
  • Participate or may facilitate department or project initiatives under the direction of department management or lead clinical trial manager.
  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality and teamwork.
  • Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.
  • Ability to work a designated schedule.
  • Ability to work on a mobile device, or in front of a computer screen and/or perform typing for approximately 90% of a typical working day.
  • Ability to work on a computer and phone simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel 20% of working time away from work location, may include overnight/weekend travel.
  • Ability to attend off-site meetings and conferences as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in the life sciences or field as outlined in the essential duties.
  • 5+ years of experience in clinical research.
  • 1+ year of experience leading project teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, analysis, close out and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Clinical monitoring experience including data review, query resolution, protocol deviation identification/tracking/trending, site initiation, site maintenance, and site closeout visits.
  • Experience writing, reviewing and editing protocols.
  • Knowledge of applicable quality standards (e.g. Good Clinical Practices (ICH/GCP), ISO 20916) and applicable local and national regulations governing clinical research.
  • Authorization to work in the US without sponsorship.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform the Essential Duties of the position with or without accommodation.
  • Experience providing oversight to external vendors (e.g. CRO, central labs, call centers, DCT providers).

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1+ year of clinical research experience with a sponsor company or CRO.
  • International study experience, IVDR, and GDPR implementation.
  • Working knowledge of the FDA submission process including, IDE, PMA and 510(k).
  • Experience as a study coordinator or clinical research associate.
  • Sample management system experience.

  • Self-management: ability to scope projects, prioritize, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have / Culture Fit

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf or Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line customer-facing IT support to employees via Slack, Jira, and other channels.

  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Manage identity and access management, including integrating SSO with providers like Okta and Google Workspace; work with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Own and improve IDP/SSO workflows; articulate solutions and create help articles; automate routine tasks.
  • Respond to, and resolve, critical incidents and issues, prioritizing tickets and delivering results through to completion.
  • Plan and execute projects across sprints; document work in Jira; align objectives with team and company goals.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholders across Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.
  • Contribute to a growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks strategy; participate in design, implementation and automation efforts.

What You Bring to Ledn (Qualifications)

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, and other scripting tools.
  • Experience with open-source tooling (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; ability to handle equipment shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a solid understanding of basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching) and OSI model layers.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work effectively with multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Desired / Nice-to-Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces for automation.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture and Outcomes

  • We value integrity, accountability, empathy, and progress; we strive for a supportive, collaborative environment in a remote-first, global team.
  • We provide a comprehensive total rewards package, including equity, remote-work options up to 180 days, and a focus on work-life balance.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion; accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Location: Campo Largo, Paraná, Brazil. This role is remote-friendly with global teams; applicants from suitable time zones are encouraged to apply.

Note: We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to them. We may ask shortlisted candidates to submit a short video response as part of the selection process.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who need assistance.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and able to work with high motivation, dependability, and experience in a fast-moving team. You will collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate communicates well, learns quickly, and seeks a supportive environment to grow IT skills.

This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.

  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta.
  • Experience working with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Strong communication skills across all media; ability to explain concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Excellent written communication for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, concise writing; culturally sensitive.
  • A genuine desire to provide a magical experience for others; strong security mindset and knowledge of PGP.
  • Fundamental networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching) and OSI model troubleshooting.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to streamline work.
  • Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We value leadership that thrives in startup or tech environments and embodies our values.

  • Builder’s mindset: eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner with empathy and clarity, capable of influencing across functions and cultures.
  • Integrity and accountability, especially in handling confidential information across diverse contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one.

  • Ownership in the company through equity; remote work flexibility up to 180 days worldwide (subject to restrictions).

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Bring to Ledn

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints). You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn (continued): 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You have provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.) You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide: As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Our Environment & Application process

Ledn Working Environment Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Data Product Manager
description:
Data Product Manager

Location: REMOTE

Annual Compensation: $110,000.00 - $140,000.00 (DOE)

The Data Product Manager leads the definition, development, and lifecycle management of high-quality, reusable data products that drive value across business domains and the enterprise. Serving as a strategic link between business and technical teams, this role ensures data products are discoverable, well-governed, and interoperable from ideation through retirement.

You will oversee the creation and stewardship of enterprise reference data, including hospitals, helipads, airports, air ambulance bases, customers, health insurance plans, and payors. The ideal candidate brings proven expertise in research, data management, and governance, along with exceptional organizational and communication skills.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Coordination (20%)

  • Lead the development and management of GMR’s reference data processes, including stewardship, versioning, and golden record creation, in alignment with data lake and analytics strategies.
  • Define data quality metrics, standards, and SLAs.
  • Address data duplication, inconsistency, and fragmentation; develop and enforce data governance policies and operating models.
  • Collaborate with IT and security to standardize data access controls and support metadata management tool implementation (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog).
  • Assess data maturity, identify gaps, and implement improvements to ensure trusted, accessible, and well-managed data products.

Reference Data Research & Maintenance (60%)

  • Build and maintain comprehensive reference data for hospitals, customer profiles, transportation providers, airports, and fuel depots to support downstream workflows such as customer experience personalization and automation of eligibility and authorization processes.
  • Conduct ongoing research to maintain a current database of all U.S. air ambulance bases, including key operational details.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures for data research, maintenance, and change management to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Leverage enterprise data hubs and services for data storage, cataloging, maintenance, and sharing across key applications.

Data Integration & Synchronization (10%)

  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including Ambulance Communications, Clinical Informatics, Revenue Cycle, and IT Data Teams—to synchronize reference data across critical systems.

Data Analysis & Reporting (10%)

  • Develop reports and visualizations for reference data, market analysis, and air/ground decision-making.
  • Analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

Qualifications

Education & Industry Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, Computer Science, Information Systems, GIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years in data management roles, including database administration, data governance, master data management, or enterprise data strategy
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational databases, and data warehouse technologies, with a strong ability to analyze and validate data quality and lineage
  • Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Domo)
  • Skilled in research, data collection, maintenance, and spatial analysis (GIS strongly preferred)
  • Background in healthcare, air and ground medical transport, or dispatch environments
  • Proven experience developing data products, managing master data, and working with metadata tools and data cataloging platforms
  • Proficient in maintaining reference databases and spreadsheets
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and governance tools (e.g., Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra) is a plus

Why Choose GMR?

Global Medical Response (GMR) and its family of solutions are dedicated to delivering compassionate, quality medical care, primarily in the areas of emergency and patient relocation services. Here you’ll embark on meaningful work that will make an impact on you and the customers we serve. This posting reflects the role and its requirements; no additional site-wide notices are included here.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable, creative in problem solving, and able to work in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We predominantly work on macOS, and you will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding departing employees. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools. You will detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix incidents as needed. You will work on projects over sprints, and document your work in Jira. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn :

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of API integrations between systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear, friendly, and concise writing.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, macOS enterprise configuration, and technical onboarding/offboarding processes.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI model; ability to troubleshoot methodically.
  • Self-management with clear scoping of projects and priorities across multiple teams.

Nice to Have : Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit : You thrive in a startup/tech environment, value integrity and accountability, and can influence across functions with empathy and clarity. Experience working in a remote environment is a plus.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, competitive PTO, ownership in the company through equity, and remote work opportunities worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). We aim to remove barriers so you can love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing the Ledn team throughout all stages of the recruitment process; requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

Flex is building a finance super app for premium business owners — reimagining every single aspect of the financial workflow and financial services for any entrepreneur. Flex is focused on mid-market businesses ($3 - $100M revenue) that are largely overlooked by existing fintech solutions and reliant on slow and outdated regional banks. We are targeting a :$1T revenue opportunity that is largely up for grabs.

Base pay range

$55,000.00/yr - $75,000.00/yr

Flex is a fully remote company and this role can be performed from anywhere.

About the Role

We\'re looking for a Software Engineer II to help build product features that power financial services. You\'ll work on systems that handle payments, credit, and other core products that our customers rely on daily to drive business operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full lifecycle of medium-sized features and tasks across our product stack
  • Build user-facing features, internal tools, APIs, and backend services
  • Write clear, maintainable, and tested code that you\'ll be responsible for long-term
  • Participate in code reviews and provide timely feedback to teammates
  • Build features with the end product and user in mind, not just the code
  • Reason carefully about how your work extends in service of larger product needs
  • Build upon systems and features that others depend on
  • Balance speed with reliability and compliance in a regulated environment
  • Collaborate with other engineers and product team members to deliver high-impact work

  • Ability to research and proactively solve problems, bring solutions to the table
  • English proficiency

Technical environment

We primarily use Typescript, PostgreSQL, and GCP. We are building in a monorepo with a lean towards rapid value creation through trunk based development. Deploying to production 3-5 times a week is the average velocity of a team member.

What matters to us: We value ownership, product sense, and clear communication. You should be someone who thinks beyond just shipping code to understanding the impact on users and the business. We\'re a small team, so everyone wears multiple hats and jumps in where needed.

Why Join Us

Flex is growing quickly — you\'ll help shape the direction of a product and company with real momentum.

We\'re well-capitalized with strong backing and a clear long-term vision.

description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Manual Tester to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in ensuring the quality and reliability of our applications by verifying functionality against detailed specifications. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in the software development lifecycle by designing, executing, and managing comprehensive manual test plans and cases. Working closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts, the Senior Manual Tester will help deliver robust, defect-free software solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations in a fast-paced Agile environment.

Responsibilities

  • Building, modifying, and executing detailed test plans, test cases, and scripts to validate application functionality. This includes covering both positive and negative scenarios to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Identifying, reporting, and tracking defects through to closure using Azure DevOps Test Plan features. Collaborate with development teams to prioritize and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Actively participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Review requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and testability.
  • Work closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts to understand business needs and technical requirements, ensuring alignment and quality delivery.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of test cases, test results, and defect reports to support transparency and traceability.
  • Perform thorough manual testing to validate new features and existing functionality, ensuring the software meets business and technical requirements.
  • While primarily focused on manual testing, understand automated test script execution and results to complement manual efforts and improve overall test coverage.
  • Provide regular updates on testing progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
  • Contribute to process improvements in testing methodologies, tools, and best practices to enhance team efficiency and product quality.
  • SQL: Proficient in writing complex SQL queries to validate data integrity and support backend testing. Ability to analyze and manipulate data sets to verify application behavior.
  • Oracle PL/SQL: Strong experience with Oracle PL/SQL for database testing, including writing and executing stored procedures, functions, and triggers to validate business logic at the database level.
  • Microsoft Excel: Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, particularly with functions like VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP, to analyze test data, compare results, and generate reports efficiently.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Test Plan features for managing test cases, executing tests, logging defects, and tracking progress within an Agile environment.
  • Manual Testing: Expertise in manual functional testing, including designing test cases, executing tests, and validating application features against requirements.
  • Functional Testing: Deep understanding of functional testing principles to ensure that software behaves as expected under various conditions.
  • Scrum: Active participation in Agile Scrum ceremonies, with a solid understanding of Agile methodologies and the ability to work effectively in iterative development cycles.
  • Defect Management: Skilled in identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects to resolution, ensuring high-quality deliverables.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ultra Edit: Familiarity with Ultra Edit or similar advanced text editors to review and analyze code snippets, logs, or configuration files during testing.
  • PeopleSoft HCM: Experience with PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM) systems, understanding core modules and workflows to better test related applications.
  • Benefits Module: Knowledge of Benefits modules within PeopleSoft or similar HR systems to validate features related to employee benefits administration.
  • Payroll Module: Understanding of Payroll modules and processes to effectively test payroll-related functionalities and integrations.

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We hire A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership and support each other relentlessly. We value autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize the global economy.

Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better, and we invite you to join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is also passionate about helping end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be adaptable to the evolving corporate infrastructure landscape and able to work in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Role Details

What You Will Do

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support via Slack, Jira, etc. We are a Mac environment.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding experience for new employees and the retrieval process for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and policies and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management (MDM/EMM) tools such as Jamf.
  • Improve IDP and SSO tooling (GSuite, Okta, etc.); document solutions and automate repetitive tasks.
  • Handle incidents to resolution; manage help desk tickets with prioritization and agile project work in Jira.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; API knowledge for system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; ability to ship and receive hardware across borders.
  • Excellent cross-media communication skills; clear writing for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Ability to write clearly and concisely; strong customer-centric approach.
  • Understanding of security concepts and PGP; networking fundamentals and OSI model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage and scope projects across teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces for efficiency.
  • Jamf and Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment, values-driven, adaptable, collaborative across functions and cultures.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package and ownership in the company through equity; remote-work flexibility up to 180 days worldwide (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career with opportunities for growth; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employment.
  • Contact for accommodation requests throughout recruitment via the Ledn team; confidentiality assured.

Working Environment

  • Ledn is global and remote-first; applicants across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe are welcome. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

title: Tech manager
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Saiba mais sobre a Lemon

Sobre o Time De Tech

O time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares e somos responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis e eficientes que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. No nosso backend usamos principalmente aws com node.js e microsserviços orientados a eventos assíncronos. Nosso principal banco de dados é o DynamoDB. Toda a nossa infra é serverless e criada como código. Usamos jest e github actions para nossos testes e deploys. Saiba mais sobre a nossa stack aqui.

Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe que está na vanguarda da tecnologia e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Ter a chance real de participar da formação de uma empresa unicórnio;
  • Fazer a diferença em uma empresa que tem um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro atualmente;
  • Conseguir aplicar soluções tecnológicas que impactam positivamente o meio onde vivemos;
  • Liderar a direção técnica do time, garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de qualidade;
  • Representar o time de engenharia em discussões estratégicas e processos de tomada de decisão;
  • Supervisionar a arquitetura e o design de sistemas complexos, assegurando escalabilidade, estabilidade e custos;
  • Ser responsável pela formação e times de alta performance na área de tecnologia.
O Perfil Que Buscamos

  • Pró-atividade para resolver desafios complexos e muita vontade de fazer acontecer, passividade não faz parte deste perfil;
  • Capacidade de inspirar e motivar o time, direcionando-o para a excelência e inovação;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos para partes interessadas não técnicas;
  • Mentalidade de ownership: responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Flexibilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e de mudanças frequentes (somos uma startup);
  • Conexão com o impacto de negócio e entendimento do porquê por trás das soluções;
  • Comunicação clara, respeitosa e madura, com abertura para dar e receber feedback;
  • Empatia para trabalhar bem com pessoas de diferentes áreas e perfis;
  • Compromisso com o próprio desenvolvimento contínuo.
Experiência Prévia / Habilidades Exigidas

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos atuando como líder ténico;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de Experiência em gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de equipes de tecnologia;
  • Experiência comprovada na entrega de projetos de larga escala e alto impacto;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo DDD, microservices e arquiteturas baseadas em cloud;
  • Habilidade para equilibrar excelência técnica com pragmatismo e entrega de valor ao negócio.
Será Um Diferencial Se Você Já Tiver Conhecimentos Em (Não Esperamos Que Você Já Conheça Tudo Isso, Procuramos Pessoas Curiosas e Que Estejam Dispostas a Aprender)

  • Experiência no setor de energia e/ou em startups de rápido crescimento;

O Que a Gente Oferece

Pesquisas mostram que pessoas que se identificam como homens candidatam-se a um trabalho quando consideram que cumprem 60% dos requisitos, já pessoas que se identificam como mulheres e outros grupos minorizados tendem a aplicar apenas quando preenchem todos os requisitos possíveis. Adoraríamos bater um papo e descobrir se você é quem estamos procurando.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético e, por isso, estamos engajados para nos tornarmos uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e caso se sinta confortável, gostaríamos de saber na sua candidatura se auto identifica/declara pertencente a algum ou alguns grupos de diversidade.

Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn is committed to building a stake for employees in the future of the company and the digital economy.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The role is customer-facing, and you will be the first line of support for employees, via tools such as Slack and Jira.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Manager of IT who will wear multiple hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right candidate has demonstrated success in similar roles within rapidly growing, security-first environments and is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of Ledn\'s growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner looking for a supportive environment to grow IT skills. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing IT support to employees (via Slack, Jira, etc.); manage Mac-based enterprise environments.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding and offboarding experience for employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and respond to issues through to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects in sprints (Jira, agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tooling (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows; strong API skills for system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; hardware shipping and customs experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching), and OSI model steps.
  • Self-management skills to scope projects and coordinate across multiple teams; strong organizational skills.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace).
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment with a values-driven approach; remote work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package, starting on day one; comprehensive benefits and PTO.
  • Equity ownership in the company; opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven role in a global digital asset company; inclusive, diverse culture; accommodation support during recruitment.

Additional Information

  • Ledn operates as a remote-first company with a global team across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume applications, only qualified candidates will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; public social media review may be conducted. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative - including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video - with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Location details : Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

Parental Leave : flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Endless opportunities for growth : Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
